# Region Selector

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RegionSelector`](gmeow-RegionSelector.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RegionSelector>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)

The encoding descriptor for an image region — carries the selector type (a [`gmeow:SelectorType`](gmeow-SelectorType.md) value) and the raw selector value (SVG path, pixel coordinates, mask data, RLE string, etc.). The canonical superset of W3C Web [`Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md) selectors, IIIF selectors, and domain-specific mask formats.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)
